notes.title: Cabbie! Demo 1.7
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353752/537af97f3ab16671c56f76ec3aa99af96ec791f6.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hello cabbies![/h3][h3]
With ongoing work to make the full game as awesome as possible there are some alterations we want to make to the demo so that it’s more in line with what you’ll expect from the full game, so we’re bringing an exciting update for you to play and enjoy.[/h3][p][/p][h3]It has the following changes amongst a bunch of minor bug fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]We’ve made the decision for the [b]boss level[/b] to be held off until the finale of the game, instead of the end of each world, so our giant chaser Sheeplet has retired and is living happily on an island with her family, so this level has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]An [b]extra level[/b] from World 1 has been added in for you to try out and see if you can beat our challenging Starleaf scores![/p][/*][*][p]The [b]training level[/b] has had an overhaul to introduce our new character [b][u]Coney[/u][/b]! The master of all driving knowledge who sets you off on your driving journey, the tutorials have also been updated to provide extra clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sheeplets are no longer the enemy![/b] They’re just cute friendly animals minding their own business, but a mysterious source is abducting them and putting mind control helmets on them to cause them to destroy the towns, it’s your job to zap them to destroy the helmets! (no Sheeplets are harmed in the process of zapping, it actually tickles, we’ve asked)[/p][/*][*][p]All levels now have tiny [b]Meeplet cars[/b] driving around as an extra challenge for you to avoid whilst racing around.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Tip system[/b] has been overhauled, now anything positive you do, including dropping of Meeplets or saving Sheeplets will increase your tip meter and result in higher tips, but if anything gets destroyed this will rest back to standard tips.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gold jobs[/b] have now been added, some glowing Meeplets will pay you more for dropping them off so keep an eye out for those big spenders![/p][/*][*][p]Everything is [b]much faster and more fluid[/b] now, the interactions you have with pick ups, charging, the speed at which the Meeplets are ready to be collected, so all in all you’ll find it a much faster paced experience.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]HUD[/b] has had a minor update to make it clearer in general.[/p][/*][*][p]All [b]Starleaf scores[/b] have been re-balanced based on all of the gameplay changes, so now you’ll find the right amount of challenge when trying to earn them.[/p][/*][*][p]You now have a [b]horn[/b], beep away with LB or CTRL!!
[/p][/*][/list][h3]We’re excited to show you everything else we have in the works and until then-
[/h3][h3]Happy cabbying![/h3]

notes.title: Cabbie! Demo 1.6 Out Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353752/9acd835be6c838a737d29501be4fc97a36eb9044.png[/img]

[h3]Hi there cabbies![/h3]

We have an update with fewer but significant changes:

[h3]Major update with 1.6:[/h3]
The scoring 'Tip' system has been updated to a new 'Happiness Meter' where you must keep the Meeplets happy by ensuring you keep completing fares, don't lose any, and stop the Sheeplets destroying the town; the higher the happiness level the higher the tip!!

[h3]Other updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The parking space in front of a building will start flashing from the time a Meeplet is coming out, so everyone will know where the next job is.
[*] Code optimizations which make the game run even smoother.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a game-breaking bug where the game occasionally entered a screen with no options to continue after completing the tutorial;
[*] Fixed vehicles colliding in menus which made them fall off podiums.
[*] During the tutorial the correct input prompt will appear when at the charging station throughout all tutorial stages.
[/list]

We're hoping everyone is enjoying the lovely weather both outside and on Cabbie's home planet.

[h3]Happy driving everyone! ːsteamhappyː[/h3]

notes.title: Cabbie! Demo 1.3 for Valentine's day
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353752/d9922fb15ea9532ba3055502fb6efbcfa6a814be.png[/img]

Happy Valentine's Day, Cabbies!

We're bringing you Cabbie Demo 1.3. 
We wanted to furtherly improve the gameplay fun so we've worked on different updates than the ones promised in our previous post. We will be bringing those much needed boss and post-match improvements in Demo 1.4. With this said, Demo 1.4 will now be the last major demo update before we'll go and build the rest of the game so you can play MORE! 

Lots of love,
Cabbie's Buddies

Updates:
[list]
[*] You now earn score for zapping Sheeplets;
[*] World 01 Level 03 now also has fireworks for awesome jumps;
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Score UI above your character no longer overlaps the job or interact UI that also appears in the same location;
[*] Post match celebrations screen shows the correct [enter] icon to continue for keyboard players, instead of the incorrect [backspace] icon;
[*] Exit prompt in the pause menu no longer disappears when you repeatedly pause;
[/list]

notes.title: Cabbie! Demo Update 1.2
Cabbie! Demo Update Version 1.1
Cabbie! Demo Out Now
notes.notes:
Hello,

We’re very excited to let you know that our demo is now available to download and play!!

You can play solo or team up with up to three friends, either locally or with Remote Play Together. The demo gives you access to play as the game’s first four characters, Cabbie, Nova, Clutch and Journey. After a short tutorial you get to take on two levels and a boss from the first world.

We really appreciate your support and hope you enjoy our demo!
